title: Weekly review
subtitle: Results, unfinished tasks and next week’s focus — in 10 minutes.

start.title: Review your week
start.hint: The review collects the week’s stats and helps you decide what to do with unfinished tasks.

stats.title: The week in numbers
stats.draftHint: Until the review is completed, numbers are recalculated when you open it.
stats.frozenHint: Numbers were frozen when the review was completed (formulas {{version}}).

tasks.title: Unfinished tasks
tasks.hint: Decide for each: keep, move to next week, set a date, park it for someday, or cancel.
tasks.appliedOnFinish: Decisions are applied when you finish the review.

finish.title: Finish the review
finish.hint: Task decisions to apply: {{count}}. A completed review can no longer be changed.
